name: 660 Stanford Shopping Center
summary: 660 Stanford Shopping Center is a premium retail address in Palo Alto's iconic Stanford Shopping Center, serving Silicon Valley's affluent community since 1956. Located adjacent to Stanford University, this highly-rated destination offers upscale shopping in an open-air environment.
demographics: Stanford Shopping Center attracts an affluent, highly educated demographic reflective of Palo Alto's Silicon Valley location, with median household incomes exceeding $150,000. The primary visitor base consists of professionals aged 30-55, tech industry employees, and Stanford University affiliates, along with their families. The trade area draws from one of the nation's wealthiest zip codes, with shoppers seeking premium brands and willing to pay for quality and convenience. Shopping patterns emphasize experiential retail, dining, and lifestyle services, with visitors typically making purposeful trips rather than browsing.
description: 660 Stanford Shopping Center is located in the heart of Palo Alto, California, one of Silicon Valley's most prestigious communities. This address is part of the renowned Stanford Shopping Center complex, an upscale open-air shopping destination that has served the Bay Area since 1956. The center is situated adjacent to Stanford University's campus and benefits from the area's exceptional demographics and high concentration of technology professionals and academics. With a rating of 4.9 stars from customer reviews, this location exemplifies the quality retail experience that Stanford Shopping Center is known for throughout the region. The property is home to QD Gallery and other premium retailers, offering visitors a sophisticated shopping environment in one of California's most desirable locations.
